free_tier_limits: Instant free-tier keys allow 60 read requests/minute, 5 write requests/minute, and 5 fulfillment requests/minute; keys expire after 30 days.
rate_limits: Token-bucket system. Authenticated responses include X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining, and X-RateLimit-Reset; HTTP 429 responses include Retry-After. All keys under one account share a rate-limit bucket.
resolution_notes: free_tier_limits: Verifier B is substantially correct; current official docs specify 60 reads/min, 5 writes/min, 5 fulfillments/min, and 30-day expiry: https://docs.opensea.io/reference/api-keys. rate_limits: Original is incorrect; OpenSea publishes its token-bucket behavior and response headers on the same official page.
